# Libraries.dev

> Nine open-source (MIT) UI effect libraries for AI interfaces, each an npm package with one React component (several also in SwiftUI): animated borders, thinking indicators, liquid effects, voice visualizers, a voice ring, view-to-view distortion waves, bot avatars, liquid metal and image-generation loaders. Plus three on-device models that let an interface respond to the user: their mood, where their voice is, and a magnet. Built to be added by coding agents.

Install a library with `npm install <package>` and read its reference before writing code; never guess a prop. Placement rules: no effect for waits under 2 seconds; Thinking Orbs for waits of 2 seconds or more; add Border Beam on the working element for waits over 3 seconds; never put two effects on the same or neighbouring elements.

## Libraries

- [Border Beam (border-beam)](https://libraries.dev/llms/border-beam.md): Animated glowing border for any React card, button or input: a light beam that travels the edge, or a soft pulse. Use for AI inputs, active cards and highlighted CTAs. Playground: https://libraries.dev/beam
- [Thinking Orbs (thinking-orbs)](https://libraries.dev/llms/thinking-orbs.md): Animated AI thinking and loading indicators: small dot-orbs with states like thinking, searching, writing and listening. Use for agent status and waits over 2 seconds. Playground: https://libraries.dev/orbs
- [Gooey (liquid-gooey)](https://libraries.dev/llms/liquid-gooey.md): Liquid, gooey effects for React: menus whose pieces merge like goo, blob morphs and image melts. Playground: https://libraries.dev/gooey
- [Voice Glow (voice-glow)](https://libraries.dev/llms/voice-glow.md): Audio-reactive glow for voice input, dictation and voice agents; reacts to a microphone stream. Playground: https://libraries.dev/voice
- [Voice Ring (voice-ring)](https://libraries.dev/llms/voice-ring.md): A voice-reactive ring of light at the centre of a voice screen: listens, thinks and speaks, takes the voice's emotion and leans toward the speaker. React and SwiftUI. Playground: https://libraries.dev/voice-ring
- [Distortion Waves (distortion-waves)](https://libraries.dev/llms/distortion-waves.md): A colourful WebGL distortion wave that carries one view into another, opening from a button, an edge or an avatar. React and SwiftUI. Playground: https://libraries.dev/waves
- [Bot Avatars (bot-avatars)](https://libraries.dev/llms/bot-avatars.md): Animated avatars for AI agents and chatbots: plush 3D characters with idle, working and sleeping states. Playground: https://libraries.dev/bots
- [Liquid Metal (metal-fx)](https://libraries.dev/llms/metal-fx.md): Real-time WebGL liquid metal material for buttons, badges, icons and headline text. Playground: https://libraries.dev/metal
- [Image FX (img-fx)](https://libraries.dev/llms/img-fx.md): WebGL loading and reveal effect for AI image generation, uploads and lazy-loaded images. Playground: https://libraries.dev/image

## Models

Model files are downloads with a free account, shipped inside the app under the Libraries.dev Model License (free for development and non-commercial apps; a commercial release needs Pro or Business).

- [Mood recognition (beta)](https://libraries.dev/llms/mood-recognition.md): Reads the user's mood (frustrated, confused, lost) from the pointer, presses, scrolling and typing, in the browser; a React kit tells components when to bring forward what helps. Page: https://libraries.dev/mood-recognition
- [Voice Position (beta)](https://libraries.dev/llms/voice-position.md): Which side of an iPhone a voice comes from and how far off it is, from the built-in stereo microphones. SwiftUI. Page: https://libraries.dev/voice-position
- [Magnetic UI](https://libraries.dev/llms/magnetic-ui.md): A real magnet pulls the interface and air taps act as input, from the phone's magnetometer. React (via the Magnet Bridge app), SwiftUI, Android, React Native. Page: https://libraries.dev/magnetic

## For coding agents

- [Agent skill](https://libraries.dev/skill): teaches Claude Code, Cursor, Codex and other agents all nine libraries and three models, and where each fits. Install with `npx libraries-dev skill` or `npx skills add Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev`.
- [How to use](https://libraries.dev/how-to-use): copy a library's prompt into your agent and tune it.
- [All references in one file](https://libraries.dev/llms-full.txt)

## Optional

- [Studio and Libraries Pro](https://libraries.dev/pro): live tuning of every option with a built-in AI agent, Pro presets and variants, the Pro skill. Business adds a team MCP server.
- [Source on GitHub](https://github.com/Jakubantalik/Libraries.dev)
- [Accessibility](https://libraries.dev/accessibility)
